body.purpose: Default reading surface — all body text, headings, and UI labels.

callout-serif.purpose: Notes, marginalia, and asides — the serif break signals an annotation.

code-mono.purpose: Code blocks, inline code, and mermaid diagrams. Fira Code with ligatures.

heading-h1.purpose: Document title — uppercase, centered, 2px bottom border. One per page.

heading-h2.purpose: Major section headings with top + bottom 1px border rules.

label-uppercase.purpose: AI prompt header label — monospace, uppercase, 0.05em letter-spacing.

shadows.name: figure-ambient
shadows.purpose: Light ambient shadow on figure images — lifts them slightly off the page.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Barely-perceptible shadow on simple cards — tonal separation, not spatial.

shadows.name: modal-scrim
shadows.purpose: Full-screen overlay scrim behind modals (figure zoom, mermaid zoom).

motion.name: figure-hover
motion.purpose: Figure hover scale(1.02) — subtle zoom-in affordance.

motion.name: mermaid-hover
motion.purpose: Mermaid diagram hover scale(1.01) — subtle zoom-in affordance.

motion.name: ai-prompt-border
motion.purpose: AI prompt hover — border shifts to slate-ink-400.

motion.name: copy-hint-fade
motion.purpose: AI prompt copy hint — opacity 0 to 1 on hover.

motion.name: footnote-highlight
motion.purpose: Footnote target highlight — smooth transition when navigated to via superscript.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Hash navigation and sidebar active-link scroll — smooth scroll with header offset.

components.name: Note Callout
components.description: Inline annotation with accent left-rule and serif text. Used via ::note MDC component.
components.html: Note: This is a technical note with an accent left-rule and serif typography.
components.css: .ds-note { position: relative; padding: 0.5em 1em 0.5em 4em; margin: 1em 0; background-color: #f7fafc; color: #1d1d1d; border-left: 3px solid #3182ce; border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0; font-family: 'Computer Modern Serif', 'Charter', 'Bitstream Charter', 'Sitka Text', 'Georgia', serif; } .ds-note-prefix { position: absolute; left: 0.5em; font-weight: bold; color: #3182ce; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-note { background-color: var(--elements-backdrop-background); color: oklch(70.7% 0.022 261.325); border-left-color: #4dabf7; } .ds-note-prefix { color: #4dabf7; } }

components.name: Side Note (Marginalia)
components.description: Right-aligned annotation in the margin column. Used via ::side-note MDC component.
components.html: This is a marginal note in the left margin column.
components.css: .ds-side-note { font-size: 0.8em; color: #626262; text-align: right; font-family: 'Computer Modern Serif', 'Charter', 'Bitstream Charter', 'Sitka Text', 'Georgia', serif; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-side-note { position: relative; border: 1px solid #3b4252; border-radius: 1rem; padding: 0.15rem 0.6rem; margin-top: -7px; margin-bottom: 7px; color: #ddd; } }

components.name: Simple Card
components.description: Bordered container with barely-perceptible shadow. Used via ::simple-card MDC component.
components.html: Card content goes here. This is a simple bordered container with a muted background.
components.css: .ds-card { font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 0.75rem 0.75rem 0.25rem 0.75rem; margin: 0.75rem 0.75rem 0.75rem 0; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.03); border: 1px solid #eaeaea; border-radius: 10px; border-color: #eaeaea; background: #fbfbfb; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-card { border-color: #1a2237; background: #141a2a; } }

components.name: AI Prompt
components.description: Click-to-copy prompt container with header bar and monospace label. Used via ::ai-prompt MDC component.
components.html:
AI PromptClick to copy
You are a technical writer. Generate documentation following the AtlasMD standard.
components.css: .ds-ai-prompt { position: relative; border: 1px solid #eaeaea; border-radius: 10px; background: #fbfbfb; margin-bottom: 10px; cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-ai-prompt:hover { border-color: #3b475e; } .ds-ai-prompt-header { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eaeaea; background: #f5f5f5; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-ai-prompt-label { flex: 1; text-align: center; color: #212b42; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-ai-prompt-hint { position: absolute; right: 12px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: #bfbfbf; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-ai-prompt:hover .ds-ai-prompt-hint { opacity: 1; } .ds-ai-prompt-content { padding: 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-ai-prompt { border-color: #1a2237; background: #141a2a; } .ds-ai-prompt-header { border-color: #1a2237; background: #0f1320; } .ds-ai-prompt-label { color: #bac9d7; } .ds-ai-prompt-hint { color: #939393; } }

components.name: Field Definition
components.description: Inline field definition with name, type, required marker, and italic description. Used via ::field MDC component.
components.html:
userId(string)*:
The unique identifier for the user.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.25rem; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; } .ds-field-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-field-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #111111; } .ds-field-type { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #939393; } .ds-field-required { font-weight: bold; color: #BB2402; } .ds-field-desc { font-style: italic; color: #212b42; font-size: 0.875rem; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-field-name { color: #f5f5f5; } .ds-field-type { color: #bfbfbf; } .ds-field-required { color: #FF7353; } .ds-field-desc { color: #bac9d7; } }

components.name: Figure (Inline)
components.description: Inline figure with caption, hover zoom, and click-to-open modal. Used via ::fig MDC component.
components.css: .ds-fig { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; } .ds-fig-img { transition: transform 0.2s ease; border-radius: 8px; width: 100%; max-width: 800px; height: auto; display: block; margin: 0 auto; cursor: zoom-in; } .ds-fig-img:hover { transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-fig-caption { margin-top: 0.5em; font-style: italic; color: #626262; text-align: center; font-size: 0.9em; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-fig-caption { color: #ddd; } }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: Syntax-highlighted code block with accent left-rule and hover copy button.
components.css: .ds-code-block { font-family: 'Fira Code', 'Roboto Mono', 'Consolas', 'Monaco', 'Andale Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.9em; line-height: 1.5; border-radius: 3px; padding: 1em; margin: 0 0 1.5em 0; border-left: 3px solid #3182ce; background-color: #f7fafc; overflow-x: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-code-block { border-left-color: #4dabf7; background-color: #2d2d2d; color: #f5f5f5; } }

components.name: Version Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped version label next to the header title. Shows APP_VERSION build arg.
components.css: .ds-version-chip { padding: 2px 7px; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 25px; color: #ffffff; background-color: #1d1d1d; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-version-chip { color: #ffffff; background-color: #939393; } }

narrative.overview:
AtlasMD renders technical documentation as a typeset manual translated to screen. The page is a grid with a marginalia column, justified body text with first-line indents, ruled section headings with top and bottom borders, and serif callouts that break from the sans-serif body to mark notes and asides. The aesthetic is technical and dense — information density is high but legible, and the reader is here to work, not to browse.

The dark mode does not abandon the manual metaphor; it deepens it. Light mode uses warm neutrals (paper-white backgrounds, gray-200 heading bands, blueprint-blue accents). Dark mode shifts to a slate palette — the primary navy ramp becomes the surface, the accent shifts to a brighter blueprint blue, and the marginalia and callouts inherit the same structural rules in inverted tones.

Components are tactile and responsive. They are quiet at rest — thin borders, muted backgrounds, no heavy affordances — and responsive when touched: figures zoom to a modal on click, AI prompts copy to clipboard with feedback, code blocks reveal a copy button on hover, mermaid diagrams scale on hover and open in a modal.
keyCharacteristics: Print-derived grid: margin column (1.5in), content column (5.5in), 1fr remainder, 0.5in gutter
Justified body text with automatic hyphenation and 1.5em first-line indent
Ruled H2 headings (top + bottom 1px borders) and accent left-rules on callouts and code blocks
Serif callouts (Computer Modern Serif / Charter / Georgia) breaking from sans-serif body
Dual-mode palette: warm neutrals + blueprint blue (light), slate navy + brighter blue (dark)
Small radii (3-8px) — the form language is architectural, not soft
Functional shadows only: figures, cards, and modals; content surfaces are flat with tonal layering

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blueprint Blue is the only chromatic accent in the system. It appears as left-rules, bullet markers, link colors, and diagram strokes — never as a fill on large surfaces. Its rarity is the point; it functions as a margin annotation, not a brand color.

rules.name: The Mode-Shift Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is not an inverted light mode. It shifts to a cooler, bluer palette: the primary navy ramp becomes the surface family, the accent brightens, and the dark-slate table colors replace the warm neutral table colors. The grid, rules, and typography persist unchanged.

rules.name: The Serif Break Rule
rules.body: Notes, marginalia, and asides use the callout serif (Computer Modern Serif / Charter / Georgia). Body text, headings, and code use sans-serif or monospace. The serif is the signal that the reader has left the main argument and entered an annotation.

rules.name: The Justified Text Rule
rules.body: Body paragraphs are justified with inter-word spacing and automatic hyphenation. This is a deliberate print-craft choice — it creates the even right margin of a typeset manual. The first-line indent of 1.5em reinforces the print metaphor. Do not switch to left-aligned without an explicit product decision.

rules.name: The Grid Persistence Rule
rules.body: The three-column grid is the structural identity of the page. It does not collapse to a single column on smaller screens — the marginalia column narrows but persists. If a future responsive redesign collapses the grid, it is replacing the manual metaphor, not refining it.

rules.name: The Functional Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear only on elements that lift or overlay: figures, cards, and modals. Content surfaces (body text, headings, tables, code blocks, notes) are flat — depth is conveyed through tonal layering and border rules. A shadow on a content surface is a bug.

rules.name: The Rule-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Structural separation is achieved with border rules, not shadows. A section break is a 1px line, not a drop shadow. An accent is a 3px left-rule, not a glow. The system prefers drawn lines over cast shadows.

dos: Do use the callout serif (Computer Modern Serif / Charter / Georgia) for notes, marginalia, and asides — the serif break is the signal that the reader has entered an annotation.
Do justify body text with inter-word spacing and automatic hyphenation — the even right margin is the print-craft signature.
Do use the 3px accent left-rule (blueprint blue) on notes, code blocks, and blockquotes — it is the primary structural accent device.
Do keep radii small (3-8px for content, 10px for cards) — the form language is architectural, not soft.
Do use tonal layering (slate surfaces, border rules) for depth on content surfaces — reserve shadows for figures, cards, and modals.
Do span mermaid diagrams across the full grid (1 / -1) — they must not be squeezed into the margin column.
Do support separate light/dark image sources in ::fig — the manual metaphor persists in both modes.
Do keep the version chip as the only fully-rounded element — it is a small, deliberate exception to the architectural form language.
donts: Don't use blueprint blue as a fill on large surfaces — it is an accent, not a brand color. Its rarity is the point.
Don't add shadows to content surfaces (body text, headings, tables, code blocks, notes) — depth is conveyed through tonal layering and border rules.
Don't collapse the three-column grid (margin / content / 1fr) into a single column without an explicit product decision — the grid is the structural identity of the manual.
Don't switch body text from justified to left-aligned without an explicit product decision — the even right margin is a deliberate print-craft choice.
Don't use red outside of the required-field asterisk — warning vermilion is reserved for that single purpose.
Don't use rounded corners larger than 10px on content components — the system's maximum content radius is 10px (cards). Larger radii break the architectural form language.
Don't treat dark mode as an inverted light mode — it shifts to a cooler, bluer palette with distinct surface colors (dark-slate family) for tables and diagrams.
